about.intro: When I finished my degree in Systems Analysis and Development in 2019, I discovered my passion for web development through JavaScript and TypeScript. Since then, I've been dedicated to building robust applications using Node.js, React, and React Native.
about.extended: I work end to end across TypeScript (Node.js, React, React Native) and PHP (Laravel, InertiaJS), from API and database design to production deployment on AWS and Azure. As Tech Lead at Luby Software, I lead technical direction for my team, define code and security standards, mentor developers, and work alongside product on complex problems.
